g.text: Rastok — current core data forms (registry: identity.md)
deadline ids / Loop / Retry / closure facts
no journal or value tag registry
Encoded bytes share Arc<[u8]>; the lazy cache is not identity.
Graph-born values use canonical CBOR. Raw bytes stay external;
the reader's port type selects bytes or checked UTF-8 text.
Three append-only kinds: INGRESS, TRANSACTION, EGRESS.
An EGRESS Call opens then closes in separate records.
Unsealed instants are required recovery evidence, not causal seal input.
Owned types and selected fields, not an exhaustive API inventory.
All boxes are in rastok-core (no_std + alloc).
The current format and allocated numbers live in docs/spec/identity.md.
